title: Pro Shop Store Credit: automatic-reload trigger level
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers when an automatic reload is considered for a tier that offers it, for every such tier of this product.

## Basis
For a tier that offers automatic reload, an automatic reload is considered once the balance drops below the tier's auto-reload trigger level. Before an automatic reload can be credited, the account's balance must already sit below that trigger level; where the balance does not sit below it, no automatic reload is credited on this check.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)
Suppose a tier's own trigger level is 20.00 USD. If the account's current balance is 19.99 USD, that balance sits below the trigger level and an automatic reload is considered. If instead the current balance is exactly 20.00 USD, that balance does not sit below the trigger level, and no automatic reload is considered at that balance.
